data.title: Add tree view as 'fleece tree' command
data.description: The 'fleece tree' command should be added, showing the list of issues (using the same filtering behaviour as 'fleece list') in the CLI based on the parent-issues property. Just show it as a normal tree using a depth first search. If an issue is referenced by two children, only show it when it is reached in the first depth first search run, but add a small 'virtual' parent indicator above the second child issue to show the connection. Update the documentation to suit.
